description: Use this when the user asks to see their quotes or proforma invoices, open or accepted quotes, or quotes for a client. Lists quotes and proforma invoices of one business, newest document date first: number, date, valid until, status, client name, currency, total, VAT and the invoice it was converted to. status is one of all, draft, sent, accepted, declined, expired. No client contact details. Do not use it for invoices (list_invoices).

business_id.description: From list_businesses. May be left out when the connection shares exactly one business.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page, with the same filters.

date_from.description: YYYY-MM-DD, document date on or after.

date_to.description: YYYY-MM-DD, document date on or before.

status.description: One of all, draft, sent, accepted, declined, expired. Default all.

name: list_quotes
title: List quotes
